# ex: rewrite type with package-qualified replacement
ex {
	import "encoding/json"

	type x json.RawMessage
	x -> []byte
}
-- file.go --
package m

import "encoding/json"

var x json.RawMessage
-- stdout --
diff old/file.go new/file.go
--- old/file.go
+++ new/file.go
@@ -1,5 +1,3 @@
 package m

-import "encoding/json"
-
-var x json.RawMessage
+var x []byte
